<thought>Both the ^13C and ^1H NMR data show a single methyl signal: the ^1H spectrum has a singlet integrating to 3 H at 3.81 ppm (typical for an O‑CH₃), and the ^13C spectrum has a corresponding carbon at ~52 ppm. No other methyl signals are present. Therefore the molecule contains exactly one CH₃ group.</thought>
